newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila eyes $3 bln from new mining investments.
newsitem.headline: Manila eyes $3 bln from new mining investments.

text.p: Foreign mining companies have proposed investing at least $3 billion in new projects in the Philippines, an industry official said on Tuesday.

The liberalisation in the ownership of Philippine mining projects has attracted investors from Australia, Canada, United States, Finland and Germany, said Deogracias Contreras, executive vice president of the Chamber of Mines of the Philippines in a statement.

Contreras said the final administrative rules and regulations of the new Philippine Mining Act, which allows 100 percent foreign ownership of a mining project, are likely to be passed by the government on Thursday.
